name: Holly Aurora Emberwhisper
source:
The other main character in the visual novel besides Leander.

Friends with Penny and Ava. 

Is thought to suffer from mild autism. 

Has a bird friend named Lynrd Skynrd. 

Always has a Santa hat on her head....
